evidence: main_0088.c:9161 onward. The body serializes the FranchiseContractOffered record and its franchise_id, player_id, player_position, contract_salary, contract_term, qualifying_offer, arbitration, renew_contract and extension keys. Caller 0x7000ccde1c invokes this record conversion.

main_0182.c:27355 onward. The body assembles environment and stadium resource paths, including scene, camera, props, walls, textures, crowd and practice cage assets. Callers 0x7001a2e850 and 0x7001a2ebfc are stadium loading paths.

main_0181.c:15026 onward. The body constructs player appearance resource paths for uniform, jersey, jacket, pants, cap and team office textures. Caller 0x70019ff2c8 and the build_player_asset_path helper confirm asset-path processing.

main_0138.c:31991 onward. The body references GrowBorderLighting, CBlurX, CBlurY and phmoundColor.culling=true and calls the lighting helper family. Caller 0x70012daee8 is indexed. These observations do not establish the routine’s specific operation.

main_0128.c:5937 onward. The body contains the exact WebP predictor_enc.c diagnostic string and GetBestPredictorForTile symbol string, with MAX_TRANSFORM_BITS checks. Caller 0x700116af10 and helpers 0x700117b480/0x700117b6f0 place it in lossless tile prediction.

main_0029.c:27131 onward. The body references four wrestling ring action labels, DP Relay Throw, Pending catch, Pre-pending catch idle and TIY Working Ring. Caller 0x70003a5d44 is indexed, but the labels alone do not identify this routine’s role.

main_0074.c:10636 onward. The body references Catch, Catch Ring, Loco Ring, Puppet Ring, Tag Ring, Throw Ring and Throttle, then performs extensive output writes. Caller 0x7000a53070 is indexed. The exact mapping or operation is unclear.

main_0127.c:40931 onward. The body contains the exact vp8l_enc.c EncoderAnalyze and AnalyzeEntropy strings and calls qsort. Callers 0x700116d530 and 0x7001188170 plus the WebP encoder strings support an image-analysis routine.

main_0142.c:50417 onward. The body processes resource labels BALL0, BALLWU1–4, BALLUP0, BAT0, BBAT0, helmet and equipment asset names while creating resource objects and dispatching resource methods. Callers 0x70013a3580 and 0x70013a5ca4 are indexed.

main_0185.c:23552 onward. The body checks streamingParams->streamFlags, TONE_FLAG_VOLUME_FROM_GLOBAL_VAR, toneVol and random volume bounds while filling an output record. Callers 0x7001abeab0, 0x7001ae0b54 and 0x7001b3d5b0 are indexed.
